text: Bear-Killer was a hobgoblin in the Lostafinga tribe, who served under Lieutenant Julla, in the mid-to-late 14 century DR. Bear-Killer wasn't his true name, but rather a nickname he had received as a veteran of the troop from sergeants Cheff and Smut, derived from him having once slain a black bear.
Baylee Arnvold was a human archaeologist, explorer and ranger. He discovered the Lost Library of Cormanthyr in the .
Belleethe Kheldorna was the Waterbaron of the city of Yartar.
Beldred Truesilver was a knight and a member of the Truesilver noble family in Cormyr in the mid-to-late 14 century DR who rode with Princess Alusair Obarskyr.
Beornegar was a well-respected member of the Tribe of the Elk of Icewind Dale in the mid–14 century DR.
Berrun Ghastkill was an adventurer and the mayor of Nashkel in Amn in the late 14 century DR.
Belwar Dissengulp was a svirfneblin of Blingdenstone and was known in the city of Blingdenstone as the "Most Honorable Burrow Warden".
Belhifet, who operated under the alias of Poquelin, was a powerful devil from the plane of Avernus in the Nine Hells.
Belshazu was a glabrezu and the father of the draegloth Jeggred Baenre.

Grand Duke Belt was one of the members of the Council of Four, the rulers of the city of Baldur's Gate. He served in this role during the years following in the Time of Troubles, in the mid–14 century DR.

Belial () was the lord of Phlegethos who, along with Fierna, his daughter, were the only archdevils allowed to share rulership over one of the Nine Hells by Asmodeus. Belial was the veteran schemer in their abnormal alliance, contributing diabolical deviousness and greater conspiratorial experience.
Bellany Tundash was a wizard who worked for the famous pirate Sheila Kree in the late 1360s DR. She was one of her more trusted lieutenants.
Beliot Sevenecho, or Beliost Sevenecho, was a human man of the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast. He was patriarch of the Sevenecho family and innkeeper of The Worried Wyvern inn in the late 1360s DR.
Berkthgar was a Reghedman barbarian from the Tribe of the Elk of Icewind Dale who served as the chieftain of Settlestone in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Bella don Delroy Harpell was a member of the Harpell family and daughter of spokesman Delroy Harpell of Longsaddle in the Savage Frontier of Faerûn.
Besnell was a high-ranking elven Knight in Silver who hailed from Silverymoon in the Silver Marches. He led the Knights in Silver against the drow during the battle for Mithral Hall.
Beluar was a heroic elf warrior of the Vast in the 7 century DR. He won a famous victory against an orc army to help save the dwarven kingdom of Roldilar.

Beldossan the Short was a human of the Vast in north Faerûn in the 7th century DR. Beldossan was rumored to have dwarven blood, thus the nickname. In the early 7th century, Beldossan assisted the dwarven priest Turbaern and the elf sorceress Aleratha Ilnatar in enchanting over a thousand weapons forged from orcslayer metal by Master Smith Fyrfar Smokebeard over several years at the order of Deep King Tuir Stonebeard, in their mission to destroy the orc realm of Vastar. Among these was the short sword Sarghathuld in the Year of the Many Serpents, 605 DR.
Bellstar was a maid in the service of Lady Polaris's chamberlain Sysquemalyn, in the enclave of Delia in Netheril, circa .
Bellas Thanatar was a human man and Supreme Scepter of the city of Calaunt in the Vast.
Beromchess Ilthyn was a priestess of Ilmater in the 13th century DR.
Berellip Xorlarrin was a drow priestess of House Xorlarrin in Menzoberranzan in the 15 century DR.
Belaur Aumar was the nominal king of Athalantar in the early-to-mid–3 century DR, but in truth he was under the power of the magelords. Finally, he was killed by his nephew, Elminster Aumar.
Ben, or Ben the Brewer was a herbalist living on the outskirts of Luskan.
Corporal (later Sergeant) Benton was the quartermaster of the Dagult Neverember's City Watch in the 1480 DR Neverwinter.
Bevemar was a cleric and a member of the Shadow Thieves around 1370 DR.
Beyab al-Rashid was a holy slayer who lived in Liham in 1367 DR.
Belinda Heavensbow was a former member of Silverymoon's Knights in Silver in the late 15th century DR.
Belereve, first son of King Holordrym, was the 22nd Obarskyr monarch and a king of Cormyr. He only reigned for two years, murdered by his sister, Rasthaele.
Besmra Obarskyr was 24th Obarskyr monarch and a queen of Cormyr. The younger sister of former king Holordrym Obarskyr, she was crowned even though her son Torst had the legal right to the throne.
Berost "the Bold", the first son of King Keldroun, was the 28th Obarskyr monarch and a king of Cormyr.
Bese al-Sedni was a marid who inhabited Huzuz, the City of Delights, in 1367 DR.
Berni'th Duskryn was the matron mother of House Duskryn in Menzoberranzan around 1358 DR.
Benju Matsutomo was a renowned samurai, head of the Matsutomo clan, and a daimyo of Aru Province in Wa in the late 1700s on the Wa Calendar.
Belhuar Thantarth was a Harper and the master of Twilight Hall in Berdusk.
Belaurant was one of the Nimbral Lords. He was an old and kindly but manipulative figure and one of the leading Elders.
Benji Sadira was a simple innkeeper living in Huzuz, the City of Delights, in 1367 DR.
Berent Thallowwood was a soldier of Cormyr in the late 15 century DR.
Belim was a count and later king in Golconda in Turmish in 1358 DR.
Berl Cuttler was a middle-aged dwarf blacksmith in the Moonsea.
Lord Merchant Belror Tethel was a dragonborn merchant from the city of Harglast, in the Windrise Ports of Laerakond.
Belurastra Stormfall was a courtesan in Essembra in 1370 DR.
Bernadette was an abjurer and a member of the Arcane Brotherhood who was imprisoned by the barber Jooge Nopsmoth in Silverymoon.
Belkram was a member of the Harpers and one of the Rangers Three.

Bestra Mornscroll was a female Chondathan human cleric of Shar in the early 1370s DR. She was involved in the plot to kidnap petitioners from the false Temple of Mystra in Wheloon for sacrifice in the black dragon Despayr's scheme to tear a hole in the Weave of magic and so form a dead-magic zone over all the Vast Swamp.
Bellanka Petrou was a short-lived member of a cell of the Cult of Reborn Flame that operated out of Sambral, one of the Windrise Ports of Laerakond, in 1479 DR.
Belnak Vikom was a dragonborn noble and a member of Clan Belnak. He was Clan Belnak's representative in Ruinspoke in 1480 DR.
Berbalangs () were evil creatures from the Astral Plane that remained there in a comatose state. When they ventured to the Prime Material plane, it was to feed on humans.
Berenn was a fire giant cleric and a servant of the Bhaalspawn, Yaga-Shura.

Bes was the Pharaonic and Mulhorandi deity of luck and chance, as well as protector of women in childbirth. Over time, his presence on Toril dwindled, and his aspect ended up subsumed by the dwarven deity Vergadain.
Beren was a sorcerer in the Golden Mane pride of wemics that migrated through the plains of the Shaar during the 14 century DR.

Bellan was an officer in the Flaming Fist mercenary company during the mid–14 century DR. Bellan commanded the Baldurain colony of Fort Flame, which overlooked the Bay of Balduran along the southeastern coast of Anchorome.
Watcher Beribold was a young cleric of Helm who worked at Luskan's Helmite temple in the 1360s DR.
Bennet was the guide for Wently Kelso's historical expedition to the sites beneath Waterdeep circa 1358 DR.

Bellodar III, known as the Sage King, was the monarch of Impiltur of the Durlarven Dynasty during the 7 century DR. He ruled over the kingdom from the Year of Sifting Sands, 642 DR, to the Year of the Covenant, 673 DR.
Bellodar II was a 7 century king of Impiltur of the Durlarven Dynasty. He ruled the kingdom from the Year of the Eagle and the Falcon, 626 DR to the Year of of the Sifting Sands, 642 DR.

Bellodar I was the king of Impiltur during the late 6 and early 7 centuries DR. He ruled for over a third of a century, from the Year of the Dragons Dawning, 588 DR, until the Year of the Eagle and the Falcon, 626 DR.
Berelduin Shondar, nicknamed Bereld the Just, was a human cleric of Helm in the mid–14 century DR.

Duke Belynne Stelmane was one of the members of the Council of Four, the governing body of Baldur's Gate, during the late 15 century DR. She was a shrewd businessperson who also was a member of the Baldurian branch of the Knights of the Shield, a secret cadre of merchants and information brokers.
Belmer Oelber Rayburton was one of the founders of Cormyr and the first Rayburton to be ennobled.
Corporal Bence Duncan was a soldier serving within the Flaming Fist mercenary company during the mid–14 century DR.

Beldarm Truesilver was a member of the Truesilver family in the late 12 and early 13 centuries DR. As declared by the prolific but somewhat dubious historian Volothamp Geddarm, Beldarm also was the secret identity of the Hullack Hawk.
Bendix was a mercenary who formed and commanded the Sailors of the Crimson Sea company based in Airspur in Chessenta and operating in Chondath in the mid–14 century DR.
Bernard was the innkeep at the Copper Coronet in Athkatla in the mid–14 century DR.

Bendensar was a thief, a former assistant in the thieves' guild of Mordulkin, and a member of the Wraith of the Inner Sea privateer fleet in the mid–14 century DR. Circa 1357 DR, Bendensar was captain of the Sea Jewel. The Wraith were on a contract with Turmish when the Sea Jewel was scuttled by the former mercenary unit called the Agency. It sunk with all crew lost. The company was still waiting for Turmish to replace the loss of the Sea Jewel in the early 1360s DR.
Belmin Gargas was a human cleric who lived in the city of Athkatla during the mid–14 century DR.
Bethla was a priestess of Ilmater in the late-13 century DR.
Beriand was a blind elder moon elf cleric of Mystra and one of the adventurers from Elven Court that answered the call to arms against the Cult of the Dragon in 1369 DR.
Berena Elkan was a Bhaalspawn berserker who allied herself with Gromnir Il-Khan during the Bhaalspawn crisis in Tethyr during the mid–14 century DR.
Belinda was a member of the all-female adventuring company the Company of the Swanmays circa 1350 DR.
Beorne Steelstrike was a caravan master who lived in Icewind Dale during the late 15 century DR.

Bellowgulp Bluefingers was a the traveling potion-peddlers and the companion of the myconid alchemist known as the Concoctor. The two traveled across the Realms selling their wars during the 14 century DR.
Bergos Freth was a drow commander of House Freth's assassin forces operating in the ruins of Myth Drannor in 1369 DR.
Benedict Shadeleaf was a rogue that worked for Company Yargo during the late 15 century DR.
Bertice Edermath was a young half-elf woman living in Phandalin in the late 15 century DR.
Bezenttar was a retired warrior and merchant inhabiting Suzail in the .
Belevan Crell, who was also later called Belevan the Unliving, was a Nentyarch of Narfell during the time of the Crell Dynasty.

Bennig was one of the Blades of the Old Man as of . On the night of Tarsakh 25, he was on guard duty at the Fortress of the Old Man together with Galban, though Bennig himself tried to sleep through the watch. After Galban warned him about a light he'd seen, the two met up with Jerumillis. They pursued the light into the Gallery of Stone Faces, where Jerumilis was attacked, and then they found Lurom's body.
Belhendar Ilistar, who was nicknamed the Stout, was the second King of the Ilistar Dynasty who ruled the city-state of Westgate.

Benjar was one of the Blades of the Old Man in the fortress of Sentinelspire. He was a part of the team accompanying Sauk to look for Kheil and secure the Erael'len in the Northern Shalhoond in Tarsakh of , conspiring to kill the Old Man of the Mountain. Benjar and Hama were Vaasans.

Berun, once known as Kheil, was one of the Blades of the Old Man, an order of assassins from Sentinelspire. After his death, he was resurrected by Chereth, and retrained as a druid servant of Silvanus.
Bex was a tiefling from Elturel who along with her partner Danis and others of their kind, were exiled from the city to live as refugees in the late 15 century DR.
Bellar was a member of the Zhentarim that worked out of their hideout in the caves beneath the Risen Road in the late 15 century DR.
Bez was a goblin warrior and follower of the Absolute that lived in the Shattered Sanctum during the late 15 century DR.
Belathra Kyndle was an innkeeper and a priestess of Sune in the mid-to-late 14 century DR. She lived in Sleeping Hollow on the Arnrock, and was the sole human on the island.
Belgin Dree was a pirate who was a loyal crewmember of the Kissing Shark helmed by Blackfingers Ralingor in the Utter East in the late 14 century DR.
Betty was an innocent cow who grazed in the Wild Pastures of the Delimbiyr Vale circa 1372 DR.
First High Lady Scion of Siamorphe Belkerri Gulderhorn was the high priestess of Siamorphe within the Chapel and Chalice of the Divine Right in Waterdeep during the late 14 century DR.
Belarus was a loyal warrior who worshiped the Lord of Battles, Tempus.

Reverend Father Benentine Boldoran was the leader of the Ilmatari monastic order known as the Ramedaran Brotherhood, circa the . He administered the Cloister of St. Ramedar, a combination prison and sanitarium in the Starspire Mountains of Tethyr.
Belast Messandar was an elven adventurer that retired after a successful career, and enjoyed a second life as a merchant of Neverwinter.
Berk was a half-orc innkeep inhabiting the city of Zhentil Keep during the mid–14 century DR.

Hawk of the Lady Beldryn Stormstone was a ranger of Mielikki and the Lord Ranger of the Mielikkian community at the Falls of Tumbling Stars, a sacred site in the Thunder Peaks north of Cormyr, around 1370 DR.
Belthar Garshin was a paladin of Torm that lived in Impiltur during the 8 century DR.
Belvyre was a noble-born scholar and Circle of the Land druid who lived in the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale during the late 15 century DR.
Bevis the Illuminator was a scribe and illustrator that lived in Zhentil Keep during the 14 century DR.
Lord Beldroth was an inhabitant of Cormanthor in the 3 century DR and a mage in service of the Coronal.
Lord Bellas was an inhabitant of Cormanthyr by the 3 century DR, and a member of House Bellas.
Bellorath was a minotaur cult leader who dwelt within the Heartcoil Deeps of the Northdark as of the late 15 century DR. He had previously been human.

Belaphar Saltune was a priest of the church of Oghma, called a Namer, based in Yhaunn in Sembia in the late 15 century DR. By around 1480 DR, Belaphar had gained great prosperity from work in an arts or entertainment industry.
Berdak the Centaur was the proprietor of the Smiling Centaur tavern in Zazesspur in the late 14 century DR.
Beldrigarr Stoneshield was a watchman in Waterdeep during the late 14 century DR.
Belihands Maskar was a stablemaster inhabiting Waterdeep, the City of Splendors, during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Berke Glorata was a Harper agent who operated undercover as a gardener for Lord Partic Thistle at Thistleflame Keep in 1369 DR.
Belmin Gergas was an inhabitant of the City of Coin, Athkatla, in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Bene was a commoner human from Athkatla, the City of Coin, in Amn who lived in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Lady Beth was a wealthy noblewoman from the City of Coin, Athkatla, in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Benji was a member of the Emerald Enclave who served the organization during the late 15 century DR.
Berost was a man-at-arms of Shadowdale in the mid-14 century DR.
Bennik Vandyrmir was an employee of Sa'Sani's Mercantile House that operated in the village of West Harbor in the late 14 century DR.
Beyl Van Yoren was a monk who studied as a part of the Dark Moon monastic traditions some years before the late 14 century DR.
Booyagh Benta was a cultist of the Absolute who served her goddess in the late 15 century DR.
Betha Horndriver was a skilled young woman who performed music in Yhaunn in Sembia in the late 14 century DR.
High Moonmaster Bero Falabara was a Selûnite priest and the leader of the Crescent Shrine in Alaghôn during the 8 century DR.
Beylia was an acolyte in the Morningstar Haven, the temple to Lathander in the city of Westgate, in the late 14 century DR.
Beluard was an apprentice to Manshoon in the mid–14 century DR.
Ben-Karad was a priest of Myrkul who died years before the late 13 century DR.
Besmer Altuth was a criminal in Scornubel during the mid-14 century DR.
Belgon Bradaskor was a crime lord of Scornubel in the mid–14 century DR.
Bernie the "Barrister" was a shrewd lawyer and representative for adventurers in the planar city of Sigil
King Belhinn Wavegold I "the Hidden," originally Helgrin Wavegold, was the second Amnian monarch of the Wavegold dynasty.
Belhinn Wavegold was an Amnian prince of the Wavegold dynasty.
King Belhinn Wavegold II was the sixth and last Amnian monarch of the Wavegold dynasty.
Captain Belars Orhotek was an officer of the Amnian Council Army who commanded the Athkatla garrison in the late 14 century DR.
Berna was a human instructor of the Neverwinter Academy who lived in Neverwinter during the late 14 century DR.
Benzoate Glycol was a rather dimwitted and extremely handsome adventurer in the city of Ravens Bluff in the 14 century DR.
Berenice was a Netherese arcanist who worked as a herbalist in Karsus Enclave until its destruction in .
Beltcher was a Netherese bard who lived in Eileanar until its destruction in .
Bereldyn was a War Wizard of Cormyr in the late 14 century DR.
Beltrar Morgrin was a War Wizard of Cormyr in the late 14 century DR, and a traitor to the Realm.
Beldina Boneknuckles was a poor commoner who inhabited the Lower City of Baldur's Gate, in the late 15 century DR.
Belnar was a person believed to be able to challenge the power of the Obarskyr royal family of Cormyr in the late 15 century DR.
Belandroon was a War Wizard of Cormyr in the late 14 century DR.
Belsarth Hawkblade was a Highknight of Cormyr during the late 15 century DR.
Belnar Buckmantle was a War Wizard of Cormyr during the late 15 century DR.
Beulla Sandfoot was a criminal who worked against the infamous Guild in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Belvedere Huntsilver was a Cormyte nobleman of House Huntsilver in the late 15 century DR.
Belundrar "the Bear" was a Baron of Galadorna during the mid–8 century DR.
Betta Feen was a human barmaid at the Ball and Chain Tavern on the docks of the Wheloon Prison in the late 15 century DR.

Belvyn was a businessman in the settlement of Bargewright Inn in the Savage Frontier in the mid-to-late 14 century DR. He was the owner of Belvyn's House of Good Cheer, a combined festhall, all-faiths temple, and rental hall.
Bert "The Weasel" Adams was a red cap boatswain of the Blushing Mermaid in the city of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Bertrand Lucere was a merchant in Luskan during the late 15 century DR.
Bertio was a member of the Dead Rats gang in Luskan in the late 15 century.

Benjamin Carrathal was High King of Callidyrr in the late 13 century DR. Like his predecessors, although he held the title of High King of the Moonshae Isles, he was considered to be merely a figurehead by the Ffolk outside of Callidyrr.

Bethany Carrathal was High Queen of Callidyrr in the early-to-mid 12 century DR. Like her predecessors, although he held the title of High Queen of the Moonshae Isles, she was considered to be merely a figurehead by the Ffolk outside of Callidyrr.

Bertrand Carrathal was High King of Callidyrr in the latter half of the 11 century DR. Like his predecessors, although he held the title of High King of the Moonshae Isles, he was considered to be merely a figurehead by the Ffolk outside of Callidyrr.

The Benevolent Old Fat Wise Man was a mysterious and notably generous individual from Far Vandmeer in the Whamite Isles. He made occasional appearances during the wild conflicts between various nations to the north. The man arrived suddenly and philanthropically donated gold to those who were losing the wars. His visits took place at some point prior to the mass death of the population in the .
Belathin was a human Red Wizard who moved to Suzail in order to remove himself from the cutthroat culture in Thay and amass power in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Belinjuk Trawan, also known as Old Juk, was an inhabitant of the Dalelands in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Belub-Zi was an influential merchant and the head of his merchant family in the city of Westgate in the late 14 century DR.
Beyard "Bey" Freemantle was a human warrior and one of the founding members of the Knights of Myth Drannor, originally known as the Swords of Eveningstar, in the mid–14 century DR.
Belford Willoughby was the son of Harvard Willoughby, a comedian and the host of the "Laff Riot" competition that was held at the Elfsong Tavern in Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Bellard was one of the bandits under Helm Stoneblade during the early-to-mid 3 century DR.
Bethgarl Nreams was a cheese trader of Athalantar in the mid-3 century DR.
Berdeece Hettir was a local woman in Hastarl in Athalantar during the early 3 century DR.
Belarian was a well-off elvish businessman and inhabitant of the City Core of Neverwinter in the late 14 century DR.
Bethany was a well-off human inhabitant of Neverwinter's Peninsula District in the late 14 century DR.
Beline Melofora was a human merchant of Cormyr during the mid-1480s DR.
Bensen Virandson was a wizard and Harper agent who worked in Cormyr in the late 15 century DR.
Betilda Bankstone was a human resident of Tyrluk in Cormyr during the mid-1480s DR.
Ben Garmond was a trader from Procampur in the Vast in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Beomult Ragner was the judge of Eaglton and innkeeper at the Eagle's Eyrie inn of that same town in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.

Bendekar was a former adventurer and the founder of the business chain known as Bendekar's Mercantile, which sold spell components across the realm. According to business ledgers found in his bathroom, Bendekar may have been one of the wealthiest people living in Ravens Bluff in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.

The Bey of Runlatha (as he was called in Ascore) was a mighty warrior (bey) from the city of Runlatha in Low Netheril, who became a hero of the Uthgardt people in their legends and the namesake of Beorunna's Well, their most sacred ancestor mound. Known as Berun in the Ruathen dialect of the Northlanders, the person of Berun was merged in tales with that of Gardolf Beorunna into a single figure called Beorunna, said to be the father of Uthgar.
Belmora was a dwarf priestess of the North and a member of the Company of the White Star in the mid-to-late 14 century DR. She died while defending her clan-hold against an invading orc warband.

Berronar Truesilver ( ) was the intermediate deity of safety, home, and family in the Morndinsamman. The Revered Mother was the matriarch of the dwarven pantheon, exemplifying the gentler aspects of dwarven character, such as mercy and generosity, while still demonstrating their iconic pragmatism and determination.

Bennesey (known as Old Bennesey) was a Sembian who was alive around 1188 DR. He participated in the discussions with King Pryntaler Obarskyr in an attempt to acquire the city of Marsember. The others in his group were Kodlos Homfast, Lady Threnka and Jollitha Par.

Bifely Lyeelm was the high priestess of Cyric at the temple dedicated to his worship in Mulmaster. She was half-crazed from her incessant scheming, though it had worked out somewhat as she managed to ingratiate herself to High Blade Rassendyll Uoumdolphin.
Bhyrindar "Silverhart" Tellynnan was a moon elf werestag and, as of , was a member of the Vel'Nikeryma and leader of a cell of the Eldreth Veluuthra operating in the north of the High Forest.
Bidderdoo Harpell was a 14th century DR wizard from the Harpell family, an eccentric clan of mages lived in the Ivy Mansion in Longsaddle.
Biggrin was the frost giant tactical commander of Akar Kessell's humanoid army.
Black Pearl was a half-elf descended from a human and a sea elf.
Bhaeryta Chassendora was a merchant from the city of Tantras in the Vast.
Bharash was a dragonborn general who lived in Neverwinter in the late years of the 15 century DR.
Bilskromminet Yakanderosstenfal was the only gnome Proven Thief of the Shadowmasters of Telflamm in 1370 DR.
Bhylqex was a mutant ixzan cleric and a member of the Xendreth, the ruling council of of Malydren in 1370 DR.
Bichan Rarkat was one of the Cloakmasters of Esmeltaran for the Shadow Thieves around 1370 DR.
Bint al-Jawzi was a dwarf merchant-rogue living on the various lands of the Great Sea in 1367 DR.
Skull Servant Bineera Ethar was a cleric that served Cyric during the 14 century DR. She led the Cyricists's activities at the Black Rift on the Plane of Shadow in 1374 DR.
Bjami Tengervaald was an old shaman in Icewind Dale in 1485 DR.
Bharavan Bhaerkantos was a merchant and member of the Thousandheads Trading Coster.
Bhevek Grimshackle was a halfling jailer at Grimshackle Jail near Phlan in 1489 DR.
Bhún Ludwakazar () was a dwarf gladiator of the Ludwakazar clan in Mulmaster.
Bimasara was the Padhrasattva of Barter within the Padhran religion.
Bimaru was the ambassador of the kingdom of Bertan on the isle of Bawa in 1357 DR.

Bezoldur Thronhand was an elderly dwarven cook that worked in the cookhouse of the Whistling Wizard inn located in Voonlar. He was one of the very few non-humans that resided in Voonlar circa the Year of Wild Magic, 1372 DR.
Bistro Battenrooj was the traveling companion of Bahooha Shortsleeves in Impiltur in 1359 DR.
Bezrar Olaundran was a member of the Olaundran merchant family in Delzimmer circa the Year of Rogue Dragons, 1373 DR.
Bilmam Amziz was a renowned shipbuilder and architect who lived in Imdolphyn as of 1479 DR.
Birdsong was a tabaxi bard who lived in Chult in the late 15 century DR. She worked at varying times as a minstrel, a merchant, and an adventurer.
Bhaergalas were solitary creatures found in temperate or tropical woodlands and jungles. It was a large predator whose favorite prey was humanoids.

Bilaerus Thongolir II was a member of the Thongolir noble family of Waterdeep in the mid–14 century DR. Known as the most prominent member of the family by 1357 DR, he was the family patriarch by 1368 DR and through 1372 DR. His consort was Eva Thongolir by 1368 DR and his eldest son and heir was Dolerphus Thongolir IV.
Bim was a farmer in Neverwinter and student at the Neverwinter Academy during the late 14 century DR.
Biaste Ganderlay was the mother-in-law of Lord Feringal Auck in the mid–14 century DR.
Bjorn was a Northman who led the village of Bjorn's Hold in the mid–14 century DR.
Bjornhild Solvigsdottir () was the queen of the Reghedmen Tribe of the Tiger during the late 15 century DR. She kept Grava, a saber-toothed tiger, as her pet.

The Black Alaric was a pirate, or more accurately, a number of different individuals each taking the name and appearance of the pirate. Over the years Black Alarics unified pirate forces during 7 major wars on the Sword Coast. This led some to believe that the pirate was one immortal individual.
Bishamon, the Wide Hearing, was a spirit who was guardian of northern Wa and the most loved by the Wanese people. He was a god of happiness through good cheer. He was one of the Eight Million Gods.
Big Honker was a young racing tyrannosaurus rex in Port Nyanzaru in Chult in the late 15 century DR.
Bill O'Shaughnessy, also known as the dreaded pirate captain Black Bill at sea, was a knavish mariner that often had shore leaves in Daggerford's Black Stone Inn circa 1372 DR.
Bhadla was a guide that lived in the Anauroch desert during the mid–14 century DR.
Bjarke Lager was a dwarf commander in Gauntlgrym in the late 15 century DR.
Binnefein Simfray was an old scout of Bregan D'aerthe in the early 14 century DR.
Bi'anza Dossouin was a drow wizard of Bregan D'aerthe in the late 15 century DR.
Bheren was an elven man that lived in the city of Baldur's Gate during the mid—14 century DR.
Bindlemint Mincemower was a gnome living in Gnomengarde in the late 15 century DR.
Bitty Bitterbreath was the Chief Cook who lived in Purfbin Doogrick's home burrow in the 14 century DR.
Bhaerusk Montalar was the proprietor of Montalar's Happy House‎‎ eatery in Suzail, active in the late 14 century DR.
Bhuraelea was an elven sorceress of Cormanthyr in the 3 century DR.
High Lord Doom Bezurgathan Indraeyan was the ranking priest of Kelemvor, the Lord of the Dead, within the Tower of Skulls in Ormath during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Bilaska Semenir was a trader who inhabited the Shining South during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Black Anzil was a feared and infamous pirate from Turmish who prowled the Sea of Fallen Stars in the early 13 century DR.
The Black Raven was a near mythical figure among the Uthgardt people of North Faerûn.
Billiam Straodwall () was a reclusive poet that lived in the Western Heartlands during the late 15 century DR. He lived in relative isolation in a modest home near Ippon's Mill.
Black Geoffrey was one of the small group of mercenaries and adventurers from Cormyr called the Iron Collar Band, active in the early 14 century DR.

Billyup Blacknee was a responsible young halfling who helped run the Blacknee's Halfhappenstance inn circa 1369 DR with his parents Buzzrip Blacknee and Broonella Blacknee, and his elder sister Breena Blacknee and younger brother Boldric Blacknee.
Billi Sharpe was an adventurer and rogue in the village of Daggerford, whose life was profoundly affected by the Witchlight Carnival.
Bill was a dwarvish pirate from the isle of Brynnlaw in the Sea of Swords in the late 14 century DR.
Bifu, whose name translated as "Big Foot," was a warrior of the reformed cannibal Kukalatu tribe of the Malatran Plateau in the late 14 century DR.
Brawler Birka was a goblin member of the Cult of the Absolute who dwelled in the Shattered Sanctum during the late 15 century DR.
Billie was a pet mammoth that belonged to a son of one of the well-off families of the Living City, Ravens Bluff, in the late 14 century DR.
Big Huido was a smuggler ringleader who worked with the infamous Guild in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
"Bigmouth" Thimsen was a dwarvish commoner from the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Bile-Tooth was the leader of the Red Fang Marauders in the Trollbark Forest in the late 14 century DR.
Blackcut was a dark one who was a member of the Glumguts family of dark creepers in the Shadowfell city of Evernight as of the late 15 century DR.
Bibeek was a musician inhabitant of Baldur's Gate who died some years before the late 15 century DR.
Bilvoy Reede was a Sharran Dark Adept and an agent from the hidden Cloister of Sombre Embrace in the city of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Birta Grougg was a dockworker from the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.

Black Dan was a pirate from the nation of Klocckbarn in the Whamite Isles. Black Dan represented Klocckbarn in a series of wild conflicts between various nations and pirates of the Whamite Isles at some point prior to the mass death of the population in the .
Black Jack was a short-lived ruler of an unknown region in the 8 century DR.
Birtron the Magnificent was a ruler of the Southern Reaches.
Birgit of the Iron House was a respected dwarven sage, old even for a dwarf in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.

Biffle Chump was a drow man, who, allegedly, was trapped in the stomach of Lolth's avatar alongside Jan Jansen, an adventurer and a turnip aficianado, who lived in Athkatla during the mid–14 century DR.

Bishtek Dlardrageth, who went by the alias of the Savage as of the late 15 century DR, was a fey'ri swordmage from Baldur's Gate who kept his identity and heritage a secret. He was presumed killed by an aspect of Malar in the late 1470s DR.
Bitterbite was an imp imprisoned within Baldur's Gate as of the turn of the 16 century DR.
Birgen was a halfling Vistani guard of a merchant caravan led by Katriana that visited such towns of Luruar as Hilltop in the late 14 century DR.
Duke Bhereu Ammaeth was the Lord High Marshal of Cormyr. He was bald. He resided in High Horn.

Bizmatec was the glabrezu that acted as the balor Errtu's second-in-command, and was sent to the Material Plane to help Matron Baenre in her quest to take Mithral Hall, while Errtu was still under his banishment.

Blackjackal was the lieutenant and later the leader of a small tribe of elves living in the eastern starwood of Cormanthor. The elven tribe once used a large area of blueberries as their primary food source, which they shared amiably with shambling mounds. When a couatl covered in strange markings fell out of the sky into the blueberry field, the elves and mounds did not think much of it, but its decomposing corpse infected the blueberries with a form of vine blight. The elves blamed their leader for this, and Blackjackal urged them to crush his head with a rock, assuming leadership for himself. Blaerla Roaringhorn was a lady-in-waiting to princess Alusair Obarskyr in Suzail, the capital of Cormyr, circa the .
Bladen'Kerst Baenre was a daughter of Yvonnel Baenre and a high priestess of Lolth.
Blasko Halamar was a stout ex-warrior and stable owner who owned Halamar's Horses in Beliard around 1370 DR.
Blakrho "Blakthroat" Phull was a former scion of the noble House Phull of Waterdeep who turned on his family and pursued a life of banditry along the southern Sword Coast.
Blaermon the Blessed was a knight of Ilmater and a member of the Holy Warriors of Suffering in the mid–13th century DR.

Bloirt Waelarn was a human male priest of Ilmater and leader of the House of the Broken God temple in Keltar, Calimshan, in the late 13th and 14th centuries DR. He was infamous for launching a holy war against the rival House of Holy Suffering in Mussum, and for his descent into murderous madness in an effort to possess the holy relic the Tome of Torment.
Blentra Whaelbuckler was an inhabitant of Marsember in 1367 DR.
Blakkal Mord was a leather-worker and council member who lived in High Dale during the mid-14 century DR.
Blacker Crow was a human warrior known for his eye-catching black and red attire.

Bleveth Carduth was a merchant that specialized in swords for hire. He was also one of the nine founding members of the crime syndicate known as the Great Goblet, and a member in good standing as of the Year of the Tankard 1370 DR.
Bleak Sky at Morning, or Bleak Sky for short, was an ice hunter shaman who ruled over the village of Icewolf in the mid-1300s DR.
